features: Recording resolution: no limits (depending on camera model)
Remote access via TRASSIR Client, Android/iOS app and TRASSIR Cloud; up to 100 connections per server; SSL encryption
Neural-network video analytics; up to 2 TRASSIR Neuro Detector channels (licenses included); other modules optional
8864R/128 INT has 64 licenses included to connect any cameras
Up to 2 monitors can be connected
Video outputs omitted: the datasheet (G27m2) states 1 DisplayPort and 1 HDMI, while the in.trassir.com page that links it describes D-SUB (VGA), DVI-D and DisplayPort
